items.stem: Under R.A. 6713, Sec. 7, for how long after resignation, retirement or separation do the prohibitions on financial and material interests and outside employment continue to apply (subject to one stated exception)?

reveal.terms: This item is about R.A. 6713, R.A. 6713, Sec. 7(b).
reveal.shortcut: Tie the fact to its section: R.A. 6713, Sec. 7(b). The one-year bar.
reveal.why_correct: "One year" is right. R.A. 6713, Sec. 7(b) says: "continue to apply for a period of one (1) year after resignation, retirement, or separation from public office".

why_wrong.o1: "Six months" is a nearby number, but not the one in the text.
why_wrong.o2: "Five years" is a nearby number, but not the one in the text.
why_wrong.o3: "Two years" is a nearby number, but not the one in the text.

items.stem: Under the 1987 Constitution, the right of government employees to do what shall not be denied?

reveal.terms: This item is about the 1987 Constitution, Art. IX-B, Sec. 2(5).
reveal.shortcut: Tie the fact to its section: Art. IX-B, Sec. 2(5). Employees may form unions (self-organization).
reveal.why_correct: "Self-organization" is right. Art. IX-B, Sec. 2(5) says: "The right to self-organization shall not be denied to government employees".

why_wrong.o1: "Strike" sounds reasonable, but the text does not say it.
why_wrong.o2: "Campaign for candidates" sounds reasonable, but the text does not say it.
why_wrong.o3: "Hold two government posts" sounds reasonable, but the text does not say it.

items.stem: Under R.A. 6713, which body has the primary responsibility to administer and enforce the Act?

reveal.terms: This item is about R.A. 6713, R.A. 6713, Sec. 12.
reveal.shortcut: Tie the fact to its section: R.A. 6713, Sec. 12. The CSC enforces R.A. 6713.
reveal.why_correct: "Civil Service Commission" is right. R.A. 6713, Sec. 12 says: "The Civil Service Commission shall have the primary responsibility for the administration and enforcement of this Act".

why_wrong.o1: "Office of the Ombudsman" names a different office or body.
why_wrong.o2: "Commission on Audit" names a different office or body.

items.stem: Under R.A. 6713, public officials and employees must process documents and papers how?

options.text: Within 60 working days, with up to five signatories
In the order of the applicant's rank
Only after the head of office signs personally
Within a reasonable time, with not more than three signatories as far as practicable

reveal.terms: This item is about R.A. 6713, R.A. 6713, Sec. 5(c).
reveal.shortcut: Tie the fact to its section: R.A. 6713, Sec. 5(c). Reasonable time; at most three signatories as far as practicable.
reveal.why_correct: "Within a reasonable time, with not more than three signatories as far as practicable" is right. R.A. 6713, Sec. 5(c) says: "processed and completed within a reasonable time from the preparation thereof and must contain, as far as practicable, not more than three (3) signatories".

why_wrong.o1: "Within 60 working days, with up to five signatories" is a nearby number, but not the one in the text.
why_wrong.o2: "In the order of the applicant's rank" sounds reasonable, but the text does not say it.
why_wrong.o3: "Only after the head of office signs personally" sounds reasonable, but the text does not say it.
